answers.question: Is this a net-metered (solar) connection or a standard connection? How did you tell?
answers.answer: This is a standard (not net-metered) connection. The bill shows a single import meter reading under the regular tariff A1-R, with no export units, no export reading and no net-metering credit.

answers.question: Which month in the last 12 months had the highest units consumed?
answers.answer: Jul 2026 had the highest consumption in the last 12 months (Oct 2025 – Sep 2026): 298 units.

answers.question: How much fuel adjustment am I being charged (shown as FPA or FCA on the bill), and for which month?
answers.answer: You are charged Rs 613.31 as FCA (fuel charges adjustment). It relates to Jul 2026.

answers.question: If I don't pay on time, what late payment surcharges will be added?
answers.answer: If you pay late (due date 22 Sep 2026), the surcharge is Rs 317.96 until 25 Sep 2026 (total Rs 7,939); then Rs 635.92 after 25 Sep 2026 (total Rs 8,257).

answers.question: Am I consuming more units than in the same month last year?
answers.answer: No. You used 159 units this month versus 176 units in Sep 2025: 17 fewer units (-9.7%).

answers.question: What are my average monthly units consumed, and how does this month compare?
answers.answer: Your average over the previous 12 months (Sep 2025 – Aug 2026) is 172.9 units per month. This month's 159 units is 13.9 units (8.0%) below average.

answers.question: How many more units do I consume in summer (June-August) than in winter (December-February)?
answers.answer: You use 486 more units in summer than in winter (2.6× winter). Summer (Jun 2026 – Aug 2026): 794 units, 264.7 per month. Winter (Dec 2025 – Feb 2026): 308 units, 102.7 per month. That is 162 units per month more in summer.

answers.question: Looking at the payments for the 12 months shown on the bill, have I been paying every bill?
answers.answer: Yes. Every bill in the 3 months shown (Jun 2026 – Aug 2026) was paid in full.

answers.question: Have my units consumed gone up or down over the last 3 months?
answers.answer: Down. Units went 298 (Jul 2026) → 235 (Aug 2026) → 159 (Sep 2026): -139 units (-46.6%) across the 3 months.

answers.question: Based on the 12 months trend, how many units should I expect to consume next month?
answers.answer: About 156 units in Oct 2026. Method: Oct 2025 used 173 units, and this month is -9.7% versus the same month last year (159 vs 176), so 173 × 0.903 ≈ 156.

answers.question: If I wanted to spread my electricity cost evenly across the year, how much should I set aside each month?
answers.answer: Set aside about Rs 8,186 per month. Your electricity cost over Oct 2025 – Sep 2026 comes to about Rs 98,233 (4 months use the billed amounts printed on the bill and 8 months are estimated from their units at this bill's average of Rs 47.93 per unit), divided by 12 months.

answers.question: If I consume the same units as last month, what would my bill be roughly?
answers.answer: Roughly Rs 10,833 for 235 units (the same as Aug 2026). This scales this month's charges and taxes (Rs 7,620.53 for 159 units) by units used, keeping the fixed charge of Rs 900; a different tariff slab or fuel adjustment can change it. For reference, your actual bill for Aug 2026 was Rs 11,180.07.
